settings.title: Shipping
settings.content:
Orders are processed Mon-Fri, and shipped within 24-48 hours with tracking available. Shipping costs are non-refundable.

Enjoy free USPS First Class (2-7 Days) shipping on domestic US orders over $50.

Express options available at checkout: USPS Priority Mail (2-3 Days), UPS 2nd Day Air (2 Days).

Thanksgiving shipping cut off dates for US:

  • November 14th - USPS First Class Shipping (free shipping)
  • November 21st - USPS Priority Shipping
  • November 24th - UPS 2day shipping Cut Off Time

International shipping is available to 180+ countries with standard and express options. Customs taxes and duties included. For more information, please refer to our shipping policy.

settings.title: Returns & Exchanges
settings.content:
Full-priced items can be refunded or exchanged if returned in original condition and packaging within thirty (30) days of delivery, accompanied by the original receipt. Items must be unworn and undamaged.

Returns are also accepted for selected sale products, with payment refunded as an Elegatto Store Credit.

Final Sale items, such as Clearance, Bundles, and Mystery Box purchases, cannot be returned.

Gift items can be exchanged for products of equal value.

Return requests must be authorized through our Return & Exchange system and sent back within seven (7) business days. Shipping costs and return label costs are non-refundable. Please ensure you meet the conditions of our Returns Policy before requesting approval and sending back your order.

Our expert artisans source the highest quality materials and meticulously craft each Pelagus Bracelet with comfort, style, and durability in mind. To keep your Bracelet looking its best, gently wipe it with a soft, dry cloth to remove dirt and oils. Avoid exposure to harsh chemicals, excessive moisture, and abrasive surfaces. Store in the provided velvet pouch when not in use. With proper care, your hypoallergenic, tarnish-resistant bracelet will remain an eye-catching accessory for years to come.

The Aegean Blue color relates to the islands of Greece and the arm of the Mediterranean Sea. The contrasting bands of amber wood color, set off by the high-shine shackle, alludes to sophisticated eclecticism of ancientness and understated pelagic-inspired confidence.
